desc_en: Deal 10 Knockback to all units in a random direction. Allies are immune to Thorns, tile and Knockback damage during this effect.

向随机方向对所有单位
造成 10 点击退。
在此效果期间，盟友免疫荆棘、
地块伤害和击退伤害。

desc_en: Give +1 [img:int] to a unit.
desc_zh: 给予一个单位 +1 [img:int]。

desc_en: Enter Raccoon Form, gaining +2 [img:int], and -2 [img:str]. Your basic attack becomes Pilfer and this becomes Scavenge.
desc_zh: 进入浣熊形态，[img:int]+2、[img:str]-2。你的普通攻击变成【顺手牵羊】，这个能力变成【捡破烂】。

desc_en: A melee attack that scatters two random pickups when it hits.
desc_zh:
一次近战攻击，
命中时散落两个随机掉落物。

desc_en: Run to any pickup and collect it.
desc_zh: 跑到任意掉落物处并将其收集。

desc_en: Summon a new crow. Castable only if your crow is dead.
desc_zh:
召唤一只新乌鸦。
仅在你的乌鸦死亡时可施放。

desc_en: Inflict Petrify on a familiar and give it +6 [img:shield].
desc_zh:
对一个使魔施加石化，
并给予其 +6 [img:shield]。

desc_en: Enter Tree Form, gaining -2 [img:int], +5 [img:shield], and Brace 2. You become immobile and immune to Knockback. Your basic attack becomes Timber and this becomes Synthesize.
desc_zh: 进入树形态，[img:int]-2、[img:shield]+5，获得2层【招架】。你【移动受限】，同时免疫击退。你的普通攻击变成【顺山倒咯】，这个能力变成【光合作用】。

desc_en: Fall into an adjacent tile, dealing massive damage to units you displace.
desc_zh:
倒向一个相邻地块，
对被你置换的单位造成大量伤害。

desc_en: Heal 2 HP and gain Charge 2.
desc_zh:
恢复 2 点生命值
并获得 2 层充能。

desc_en: Shoot a blast of water that deals 3 Knockback. This spell has recoil.
desc_zh:
发射一道水流，
造成 3 格击退。
此法术具有反作用力。

desc_en: Create a tall grass tile, then all enemies on grass element tiles take 1 damage.
desc_zh:
制造一个高草地块，
然后所有位于草元素地块上的
敌方单位受到 1 点伤害。

desc_en: Create a water tile, then all allies on water element tiles heal 2 HP.
desc_zh:
制造一个水地块，
然后所有位于水元素地块上的
盟友恢复 2 点生命值。

desc_en: Blow a unit ten tiles away from you. This doesn't deal Knockback damage.
desc_zh:
将一个单位吹飞十格远。
这不会造成击退伤害。

desc_en: Explode.
desc_zh: 爆炸。

desc_en:
A melee attack.
[s:.7](This spell costs 0 mana. Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
一次近战攻击。
[s:.7](此法术消耗 0 法力。
每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Entangle units in an area.
desc_zh: 缠绕一个区域内的单位。

desc_en: Inflicts Sleep on units in an area.
desc_zh: 对一个区域内的单位施加睡眠。

desc_en:
Each familiar gains All Stats Up 2 and heals to full.
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
使每个使魔获得 2 层
全属性提升并恢复满生命值。
[s:.7](每场战斗限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en:
Make a target unit The Alpha.
PASSIVE: The first spell the Alpha casts each turn is cast twice.
desc_zh:
使一个目标单位成为首领。
被动：首领每回合施放的
第一个法术会施放两次。

desc_en: Grow tall grass tiles in an area and give units in that area +3 Diminishing Health Regeneration
desc_zh:
在一个区域内生长高草地块，
并给予该区域内的
单位 +3 生命恢复 (递减)。

desc_en: Throw an egg. If the egg lands in an empty tile, it hatches into a random animal friend at the start of its second turn.
desc_zh: 扔出1颗蛋。如果蛋落在空格上，那么在它第2回合开始时随机孵出1个动物伙伴。

desc_en:
Spawn squirrels on each adjacent tile, then enter Squirrel Form.
Your basic attack becomes Chitter and this becomes Birth Squirrel.
desc_zh:
在每个相邻地块生成松鼠，
然后进入松鼠形态。
你的基础攻击变为吱吱叫，
此技能变为诞生松鼠。

desc_en:
Summon a squirrel.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
召唤一只松鼠。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Each squirrel gains +2 Damage and +2 [img:spd].
desc_zh: 每只松鼠获得 +2 伤害和 +2 [img:spd]。

desc_en: Spawn a glowing mushroom that restores mana to nearby units on its turn.
desc_zh:
生成一个发光蘑菇，
在其回合时恢复
附近单位的法力值。

desc_en: Give Health Regeneration 1 to units in an area.
desc_zh:
给予一个区域内的
单位 1 层生命恢复。

desc_en: Give a unit +1 Bonus Move.
desc_zh: 给予一个单位 +1 奖励移动。

desc_en:
Enter Elk Form, gaining +8 [img:spd], -2 [img:int], -2 [img:con], and Trample 3. You ignore tile effects while moving.
Your basic attack becomes Antler Swipe and this becomes Prance.
desc_zh:
进入驼鹿形态，获得 +8 [img:spd]，
-2 [img:int]，-2 [img:con]，以及 3 层践踏。
你在移动时无视地块效果。
你的基础攻击变为鹿角横扫，
此技能变为腾跃。

desc_en: Toss a unit up to four tiles away. Inflict Bruise on it and any unit it lands on.
desc_zh:
将一个单位向外抛掷最多四格远。
对它及其砸中的任何单位施加淤伤。

desc_en: Refresh your movement action.
desc_zh: 刷新你的移动行动。

desc_en:
Enter Mockingbird Form, gaining flying movement, +2 [img:lck], and -2 [img:str].
Your basic attack becomes Mock Song and this becomes Tease.
desc_zh:
进入嘲鸫形态，获得飞行移动，
+2 [img:lck]，和 -2 [img:str]。
你的基础攻击变为嘲弄之歌，
此技能变为戏弄。

desc_en: Give each unit within an area All Stats Down 2 until the end of their next turn.
desc_zh:
给予一个区域内的
每个单位 2 层全属性下降，
直到其下一回合结束。

desc_en: Inflict Madness 1 on a unit.
desc_zh: 对一个单位施加 1 层疯狂。

desc_en: Summon a random animal that falls from the sky onto a random enemy, dealing damage.
desc_zh:
召唤一只随机动物，
从天而降落在一个随机敌人身上，
造成伤害。

desc_en: Dash forward and attack with knockback.
desc_zh: 向前突进，同时攻击一次，会击退。

desc_en: Attack everything around you 3 times.
desc_zh:
攻击你周围的
所有目标 3 次。

desc_en: A melee attack that inflicts Burn 3.
desc_zh: 造成 3 层燃烧的近战攻击。

desc_en: A melee attack that inflicts Freeze.
desc_zh: 施加冻结的近战攻击。

desc_en: A melee attack that has a 25% chance to inflict Stun.
desc_zh:
有 25% 几率施加
晕眩的近战攻击。

desc_en: A weak melee attack that has a chance to hit multiple times.
desc_zh:
一次有几率多次命中的
微弱近战攻击。

desc_en: An attack that hits a half circle around you.
desc_zh: 攻击你周围的半圆区域。

desc_en: Jump to an open tile within range, then inflict Bruise on all adjacent units.
desc_zh: 跳到范围之内的一个空格，然后对前后左右相邻的所有单位施加【瘀伤】。

desc_en: Punch a unit into the air, lobbing it back 3 tiles.
desc_zh:
将一个单位击飞到空中，
使其向后抛射 3 个地块。

desc_en: Counterattack all attacks until your next turn.
desc_zh:
在你的下一回合之前
反击所有攻击。

desc_en: An attack that hits 2 tiles in front of and behind you.
desc_zh:
攻击你前后方各 
2 个地块的范围。

desc_en: A melee attack that deals 1 damage.
desc_zh: 造成 1 点伤害的近战攻击。

desc_en: Inflict Bruise on a unit.
desc_zh: 对一个单位施加淤伤。

desc_en: Knockback a unit 2 tiles.
desc_zh: 将一个单位击退 2 个地块。

desc_en:
Charge up a mega punch.
[s:.7](This punch will be unleashed on your next turn.)[/s]
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
积蓄一记超级拳。
[s:.7](此拳将在你的下一回合释放。)[/s]
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en:
Refresh your basic attack and movement action.
Fall asleep at the end of the turn.
desc_zh:
刷新你的基础攻击和移动行动。
回合结束时陷入睡眠。

desc_en: Give a unit +4 [img:str] and Confusion 2.
desc_zh: 给予一个单位 +4 [img:str] 和 2 层混乱。

desc_en: Move one tile diagonally.
desc_zh: 沿对角线移动一格。

desc_en: Move in front of an enemy.
desc_zh: 移动到一个敌人面前。

desc_en: Your movement range is doubled until the end of the turn.
desc_zh: 你的移动距离翻倍，直到回合结束。

desc_en:
Punch a unit into SPACE!
[s:.7]They will fall back down at the end of the round.[/s]
desc_zh:
把一个单位打进太空！
[s:.7]它们会在回合结束时掉下来。[/s]

desc_en: All enemies within 3 tiles move toward you.
desc_zh: 3格之内所有敌人都会朝你的方向移动。

desc_en: Jump to a tile and pull enemies toward you when you land.
desc_zh:
跳跃至一个地块，
落地时将敌人拉向你。

desc_en: Gain +5 [img:str] and Bruise 5. This ability becomes Berserker Dash.
desc_zh:
获得 +5 [img:str] 和 5 层淤伤。
此能力变为狂暴冲刺。

desc_en: A short range dash attack.
desc_zh: 突进攻击，距离较短。

desc_en:
Force a unit to move towards you.
RELOAD: Kill something.
desc_zh:
强迫1个单位朝你的方向移动。
冷却结束：杀掉点什么。

desc_en:
A weak melee attack.
RELOAD: Kill something.
desc_zh:
一次较弱的近战攻击。
装填：击杀任意目标。

desc_en:
Your [img:int] becomes 0. You can attack an extra time each turn for the rest of the battle.
This ability becomes MORE ANGRIER!!!
desc_zh:
你的 [img:int] 变为 0。
在战斗剩余时间内，
你每回合可以额外攻击一次。
此能力变为更生气！！！

desc_en: Lose all of your mana and gain that much [img:str] until the end of the turn.
desc_zh: 失去所有魔能。失去多少魔能，这个回合结束之前，[img:str]就提升多少。

desc_en: Inflict Sleep on an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 对相邻单位施加睡眠。

desc_en: Immobilize an adjacent unit for as long as you remain adjacent.
desc_zh:
定身一个相邻单位，
只要你们保持相邻状态。

desc_en:
Take damage equal to your [img:int].
The next spell you cast this turn is free.
desc_zh:
受到等同于你有 [img:int] 的伤害。
你本回合施放的下一个法术免费。

desc_en:
Your movement action becomes a dash attack.
This ability becomes Reposition.
desc_zh:
你的移动行动变为冲刺攻击。
此能力变为调整位置。

desc_en: Move up to two tiles.
desc_zh: 移动最多两格。

desc_en:
Throw your weapon at a unit. The weapon breaks.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
把你的武器砸向1个单位。武器会损坏。
[s:.7]（每个回合可以施放1次）[/s]

desc_en:
Drop to 1 HP.
Damage you deal to bleeding units has Lifesteal.
This spell becomes Lacerate.
desc_zh:
生命值降至 1。
你对流血单位造成的伤害
具有生命偷取效果。
此法术变为撕裂。

desc_en: A melee attack that inflicts Bleed 2.
desc_zh: 一次近战攻击，造成 2 层流血。

desc_en:
Dash forward one tile and attack with knockback.
[s:.7](This spell's mana cost increases by 2 at the end of each of your turns.)[/s]
desc_zh:
向前冲刺一格并攻击，造成击退。
[s:.7]（在你的每回合结束时，
此法术的法力消耗增加 2。）[/s]

desc_en:
Take an extra turn. You have Madness 1 and Confusion 1 on that turn.
[s:.7](This spell can't be cast on extra turns.)[/s]
desc_zh:
获得一个额外回合。在该回合中，
你有 1 层疯狂和 1 层混乱。
[s:.7]（此法术无法在额外回合中施放。
）[/s]

desc_en:
Jump up to 2 tiles.
Damage, knockback, and inflict Burn 3 on the unit you land on and all adjacent units.
[s:.7](Adjacent units take half damage.)[/s]
desc_zh:
跳跃最多 2 格。
对你落点上的单位及
所有相邻单位造成伤害、
击退和 3 层燃烧。
[s:.7]（相邻单位受到一半伤害。）[/s]

desc_en:
A melee attack that deals 8 damage.
[s:.7](This spell's damage is reduced by 1 and mana cost is reduced by 2 each time it's cast.)[/s]
desc_zh:
造成 8 点伤害的近战攻击。
[s:.7]（每次施放此法术时，
伤害减少 1 点，
法力消耗减少 2 点。）[/s]

desc_en: Suck all units in a straight line 1 tile toward you.
desc_zh:
将直线上的所有单位
向你吸取 1 格。

desc_en: A melee attack that hits twice. Each punch inflicts Bruise 1.
desc_zh:
造成两次打击的近战攻击。
每次拳击造成 1 层淤伤。

desc_en: You and each allied cat do a spin attack at the same time.
desc_zh: 你和友方所有猫同时打出一次旋转攻击。

desc_en: You and each allied cat gain +2 [img:shield] and knockback adjacent units 2 tiles.
desc_zh: 你和友方所有猫[img:shield]+2，同时把前后左右相邻的单位击退2格。

desc_en: You and each allied cat give adjacent units +1 Damage and +2 [img:spd].
desc_zh:
你和每只友方猫咪给予相邻单位
 +1 伤害和 +2 [img:spd]。

desc_en: A melee attack that increases its damage by 1 each time you take damage.
desc_zh:
一次近战攻击，
你每受到一次伤害，
其伤害增加 1 点。

desc_en:
Deal damage, knockback, and knockback damage equal to your [img:str].
Reduce this spell's mana cost by 1 each time you take damage.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
造成等同于你 [img:str] 的伤害、
击退和击退伤害。
你每受到一次伤害，
此法术的法力消耗减少 1 点。
[s:.7]（每回合限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: A weak melee attack. If this kills anything, you become the Alpha. If you are the Alpha, this spell deals 5 additional damage and inflicts Bruise.
desc_zh:
一次较弱的近战攻击。
如果这击杀了任意目标，
你将成为首领。如果你是首领，
此法术造成 5 点
额外伤害并施加淤伤。

desc_en: Move toward the closest enemy. The dumber you are, the farther you move.
desc_zh:
向最近的敌人移动。
你越笨，移动得越远。

desc_en: The next time an enemy moves through an adjacent tile, cancel its movement and attack it.
desc_zh:
下次敌人移动经过相邻地块时，
取消其移动并攻击它。

desc_en:
Equip a temporary Stick!
[s:.7](Your weapon slot must be empty.)[/s]
desc_zh:
装备一把临时木棍！
[s:.7](你的武器槽必须为空。)[/s]

desc_en: Toss an adjacent unit at a random unit.
desc_zh:
将一个相邻单位
投掷向随机单位。

desc_en:
A melee attack.
This spell's mana cost increases by 2 each time it's cast.
desc_zh:
一次近战攻击。
每次施放此法术，
其法力消耗增加 2 点。

desc_en: A huge punch that breaks your paw... (You get -1 [img:str] permanently.)
Knock back a unit 4 tiles, then dash forward and attack it.
desc_zh:
将一个单位击退 4 格，
然后向前冲刺并攻击它。

desc_en: Attack an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 攻击前后左右相邻的1个单位。

desc_en: Attack an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 攻击前后左右相邻的1个单位。

desc_en: An attack that hits all units in a straight line.
desc_zh: 攻击直线上所有单位的招式。

desc_en: An attack that hits all units in a perpendicular line.
desc_zh: 攻击垂直线上所有单位的招式。

desc_en: Spawn a maggot familiar.
desc_zh: 召唤一个蛆虫使魔。

desc_en: Spawn a pooter familiar.
desc_zh: 召唤一个狙击蝇使魔。

desc_en: Inflict Marked on a unit.
desc_zh: 对一个单位施加标记。

desc_en: Fire a bunch of shots randomly in an area.
desc_zh: 向一个区域随机发射一堆子弹。

desc_en: Fire a shot that spawns brambles in an area.
desc_zh:
发射一发子弹，
在一个区域生成荆棘丛。

desc_en: Set a trap within 5 tiles that damages and immobilizes units that walk over it.
desc_zh:
在 5 格范围内设置一个陷阱，
对踩上的单位
造成伤害并使其定身。

desc_en: Hook onto something in a straight line and drag yourself to it.
desc_zh:
钩住直线上的某物
并将自己拉向它。

desc_en: Shoot twice.
desc_zh: 射击两次。

desc_en: Shoot four projectiles in an X shape.
desc_zh: 呈 X 形发射四枚投射物。

desc_en: Set a bait trap that attracts enemies.
desc_zh: 设置1个诱饵陷阱，会吸引敌人。

desc_en: Toss a bomb that explodes and knocks units away.
desc_zh:
投掷一枚炸弹，
爆炸并击退单位。

desc_en: Spawn brambles on any tile.
desc_zh: 在任意地块上生成荆棘。

desc_en: Shoot a projectile that inflicts Burn 2 and lights fires.
desc_zh:
发射一枚造成 2 层燃烧
并点火的投射物。

desc_en: Increase your movement. You're unaffected by tile effects until the end of the turn.
desc_zh:
提升你的移动力。
直到回合结束前
不受地块效果影响。

desc_en: Aim at a unit. On your next turn, shoot a projectile that always crits and ignores shield at that unit.
desc_zh:
瞄准一个单位。在你的下一回合，
向该单位发射一枚必定暴击
且无视护盾的投射物。

desc_en: Shoot a projectile that spawns glass.
desc_zh: 发射一枚生成玻璃的投射物。

desc_en: Teleport to any grass or water tile.
desc_zh: 传送到任意草地或水地块。

desc_en: Give a unit +3 range and reach until the end of their next turn.
desc_zh:
使一个单位获得 +3 射程和近战范围，
直到其下一回合结束。

desc_en: Shoot a random unit within range.
desc_zh: 射击射程内的一个随机单位。

desc_en: Shoot a needle that deals damage, gives Thorns, and ignores shield.
desc_zh:
发射一枚针刺，造成伤害，
施加荆棘，并无视护盾。

desc_en: Set a trap that deals 8 damage.
desc_zh: 设置一个造成 8 点伤害的陷阱。

desc_en: Shoot a flea at a unit.
desc_zh: 向一个单位发射跳蚤。

desc_en: Set a trap that webs non-bug units that walk through it.
desc_zh:
设置一个陷阱，
对穿过的非虫类单位施加蛛网。

desc_en: Deal 1 damage to a unit. If this kills it, refresh your basic attack.
desc_zh:
对一个单位造成 1 点伤害。
如果将其击杀，
刷新你的基础攻击。

desc_en: A shot that damages and inflicts Charm.
desc_zh: 射击造成伤害并施加魅惑。

desc_en: Shoot 5 weak shots, each one has a 50% chance to miss.
desc_zh:
进行 5 次弱力射击，
每次有 50% 几率未命中。

desc_en: Shoot a high damage shot with a 50% chance to miss.
desc_zh:
进行一次高伤害射击，
有 50% 几率未命中。

desc_en:
End your turn. On your next turn, your ranged abilities deal double damage.
[s:.7](Castable only if you haven't taken any other actions this turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
结束你的回合。在你的下一回合，
你的远程技能造成双倍伤害。
[s:.7](仅限本回合未进行
其他行动时施放。)[/s]

desc_en: Throw a spider egg that spawns 3 spiderlings on impact.
desc_zh:
投掷一枚蜘蛛蛋，
撞击时生成 3 只小蜘蛛。

desc_en: Fire a shot exactly 6 tiles away that ignores shield and can't miss.
desc_zh:
向正好 6 格外的目标射击，
无视护盾且必中。

desc_en: Shoot a pebble. All enemies within 3 tiles move toward it.
desc_zh:
发射一颗小石子。
范围 3 格内的所有敌人
都会向它移动。

desc_en: Gain +1 Bonus Attack at the start of your next turn.
desc_zh:
在你的下回合开始时
获得 +1 奖励攻击。

desc_en: Teleport up to 5 tiles away. Set a bear trap on the tile you teleported from.
desc_zh:
传送到最远 5 格处。
在你传送前的地块上
设置一个捕兽夹。

desc_en: Toss a spider egg that deals low damage and inflicts Infested.
desc_zh:
投掷一枚蜘蛛蛋，
造成少量伤害并施加寄生。

desc_en: Destroy a body. Equip a piece of Cat Hide armor to an empty armor slot.
desc_zh:
销毁一具尸体。
在空护甲槽装备一件猫皮护甲。

desc_en: The next time an enemy ends movement in your basic attack range, attack it.
desc_zh:
下一次有敌人在你
基础攻击范围内结束移动时，
对其进行攻击。

desc_en: Inflict Charm on a unit. If it's an enemy, it takes an extra turn immediately.
desc_zh:
对一个单位施加魅惑。如果是敌人，
它将立即获得一个额外回合。

desc_en: Spawn a charmed Tom Tom.
desc_zh: 生成1个【洗脑】的浪浪。

desc_en:
Until next turn, allied cats gain a bonus ability that can let you shoot a tile of their choice.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
直到下一回合，
盟友猫咪获得一个额外技能，
可让你射击他们选择的地块。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en:
Instructs your friend to shoot an adjacent tile!
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
指示你的朋友射击相邻地块！
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Collect an adjacent pickup and gain +1 Bonus Attack instead of its normal effects.
desc_zh:
收集一个相邻的掉落物，
并获得 +1 奖励攻击，
取代该物品的正常效果。

desc_en: Spawn a trap that deals damage and inflicts Charm 1.
desc_zh:
生成一个造成伤害
并施加 1 层魅惑的陷阱。

desc_en: Shoot a projectile that bounces everything adjacent to it back 3 tiles.
desc_zh:
发射一颗投射物，
将与其相邻的所有目标击退 3 格。

desc_en: You and adjacent units each heal 5 HP.
desc_zh: 你和相邻单位各恢复 5 点生命值。

desc_en: A ranged shot that heals and inflicts Charmed 1.
desc_zh:
一发治疗目标并施加 
1 层魅惑的远程射击。

desc_en: A melee attack that spawns a baited bear trap if it kills a unit or destroys a body.
desc_zh:
一种近战攻击，
如果击杀单位或摧毁尸体，
则会生成一个诱饵捕兽夹。

desc_en: Give yourself or an adjacent unit +1 Poison Lace.
desc_zh:
给予自己或一个
相邻单位 +1 层涂毒。

desc_en: Each familiar in an area gains All Stats Up and heals 4 HP. Other units in the area gain +1 [img:con] and heal 2 HP.
desc_zh:
范围内的
每个使魔获得全属性提升
并恢复 4 点生命值。
范围内的
其他单位获得 +1 [img:con] 
并恢复 2 点生命值。

desc_en: Spawn a spider egg trap that inflicts Infested 4.
desc_zh: 生成1个蜘蛛卵陷阱，可以施加4层【滋生】。

desc_en:
Inflict Marked 5 on a unit. 
RELOAD: Kill an enemy.
desc_zh:
对一个单位施加 5 层标记。
装填：击杀一名敌人。

desc_en: Spawn bear traps on each adjacent tile.
desc_zh: 在前后左右相邻的所有方格生成捕兽夹。

desc_en: Shoot a tear.
desc_zh: 发射眼泪。

desc_en: Explode the nuke and mass damage everything.
desc_zh: 引爆核弹，对全场造成大量伤害。

desc_en: Explode the nuke and mass damage everything.
desc_zh: 引爆核弹，对全场造成大量伤害。

desc_en: Inflict Fear on all enemies.
desc_zh: 对所有敌人施加【害怕】。

desc_en:
Revive all bodies, fully heal all units, and clear all status effects.
[s:.7](This spell can be cast only once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
复活所有尸体，令所有单位生命回满，同时清除所有状态效果。
[s:.7]（一场战斗只能施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: Cast any random spell. The spell is usually good.
desc_zh:
施放任意随机法术。
法术通常是有益的。

desc_en: Deals a random amount of damage. Requires line of sight
desc_zh: 造成随机数值的伤害。

desc_en: Displace a target unit to a random location.
desc_zh: 将目标单位置换到随机位置。

desc_en: Spend all of your mana and gain that many random buffs.
desc_zh:
消耗你所有的法力值，
获得等量的随机增益。

desc_en: A water spell that deals damage and knockback in a large area.
desc_zh:
造成伤害和大范围
击退的水系法术。

desc_en: A lightning bolt that has a 25% chance to Stun.
desc_zh:
一道有 25% 几率
造成晕眩的闪电。

desc_en: A fireblast that inflicts Burn 2 in an area.
desc_zh: 火焰冲击，在1片区域施加2层【灼烧】。

desc_en: Shoot a blast of ice in a line that freezes the first unit it hits.
desc_zh: 发射一道冰霜冲击，沿直线飞行，会【冻住】命中的第一个单位。

desc_en: A high damage spell that hits a single target.
desc_zh: 高伤害法术，可以命中单个目标。

desc_en: Shoot an infinite-range projectile that can't miss.
desc_zh:
发射一颗必中的
无限射程投射物。

desc_en: A fire spell that inflicts Burn 1 and spawns fires in a perpendicular line.
desc_zh:
施加 1 层燃烧并在垂直线上
生成火焰的火系法术。

desc_en:
Target a tile. At the start of your next turn, unleash an extremely high damage mega beam on that tile.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
以一个地块为目标。
在你的下个回合开始时，
对该地块释放
伤害极高的超级光线。
[s:.7]（每回合限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: Summon meteors that hit random tiles in a large area. These meteors have a chance to stun, spawn fires, or leave rocks behind.
desc_zh:
召唤流星打击
大范围内的随机地块。
这些流星有几率造成晕眩、
生成火焰或留下岩石。

desc_en: Deal high damage in a cone.
desc_zh: 在锥形范围内造成高伤害。

desc_en: Inflict Slow on a unit.
desc_zh: 对1个单位施加【迟缓】。

desc_en: Get big.
desc_zh: 变大。

desc_en: A wind spell that hits an entire line with Knockback 1.
desc_zh:
对整条直线造成 
1 格击退的风系法术。

desc_en: Teleport diagonally any distance.
desc_zh: 沿对角线传送任意距离。

desc_en: Teleport to any tile.
desc_zh: 传送到场上任一方格。

desc_en: Switch positions with any unit.
desc_zh: 跟场上任一单位交换位置。

desc_en: Spend all of your mana and heal that much HP.
desc_zh:
消耗你所有的法力
并恢复等量的生命值。

desc_en: Give all of your mana to a unit in range 3.
desc_zh:
将你所有的法力
给予 3 格内的一个单位。

desc_en: Give 2 mana to a unit.
desc_zh: 给予一个单位 2 点法力。

desc_en: Teleport onto a unit, dealing damage to yourself and that unit.
desc_zh:
传送到一个单位上，
对你自己和该单位造成伤害。

desc_en: Teleport to a random tile.
desc_zh: 传送到一个随机地块。

desc_en: Heal and inflict Freeze 1 on a unit in range 3.
desc_zh:
治疗 3 格内的
一个单位并对其施加 1 层冻结。

desc_en: Knock back each unit adjacent to a chosen tile 1 space.
desc_zh:
将所选地块相邻的
每个单位击退 1 格。

desc_en: Deal ice damage in a wide line with Knockback 1 that inflicts Freeze.
desc_zh:
在宽直线范围内
造成冰霜伤害，
造成击退 1，并施加冻结。

desc_en: Deal fire damage and inflict Burn 8 to all units in a large circle around you.
desc_zh:
对你周围大圆范围内的
所有单位造成火焰伤害
并施加 8 层燃烧。

desc_en: Shoot lightning bolts in eight directions with a 50% chance to Stun.
desc_zh:
向八个方向发射闪电，
有 50% 几率造成晕眩。

desc_en:
Injure yourself, then restore 15 mana.
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
伤害你自己，然后恢复 15 点法力。
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en:
Damage and inflict Burn 7 on all enemies and light the map on fire. There will be permanent consequences for casting this spell…
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
伤害并对所有敌人施加 7 层燃烧，同时点燃整张地图。
施放此法术将会有永久性后果…
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en:
Knock back and damage all enemies, then flood the entire map. There will be permanent consequences for casting this spell…
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
击退并伤害所有敌人，
然后淹没整张地图。
施放此法术将会有永久性后果…
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: Create a whirlpool that spins units and inflicts Confusion on them.
desc_zh:
制造一个漩涡，
旋转单位并对其施加混乱。

desc_en: Shoot lightning that chains randomly to other nearby units up to 2 tiles away.
desc_zh:
发射闪电，
随机连锁至 2 格内
的其他附近单位。

desc_en: A melee attack that instantly kills frozen units. If used on a boss, it instead removes Frozen to deal 15 damage and inflict Slow 2.
desc_zh:
一种近战攻击，
可秒杀冻结单位。
如果对 Boss 使用，
则改为移除冻结效果，
造成 15 点伤害
并施加 2 层减速。

desc_en:
Strike all enemies with lightning, inflicting Stun. There will be permanent consequences for casting this spell…
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
用闪电打击所有敌人，
施加晕眩。
施放此法术将会有永久性后果…
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: Cast a fire/electric spell that inflicts Burn 1 and has a 15% chance to inflict Stun in an X shaped area.
desc_zh:
施放火焰/电击法术，
在 X 形区域内造成 1 层燃烧，
并有 15% 几率施加晕眩。

desc_en: Shoot an ice/electric bolt in a straight line. It inflicts Slow 2, has a 25% chance to Stun and a 25% chance to Freeze.
desc_zh:
沿直线发射一枚冰/电弹。
造成 2 层减速，
有 25% 几率造成晕眩，
25% 几率造成冻结。

desc_en: Cast a fire/ice spell that inflicts Burn 2, Slow 2 and Knockback 2 on all units around you.
desc_zh:
施放火焰/冰霜法术，
对你周围的所有单位
造成 2 层燃烧、
2 层减速和击退 2。

desc_en: Injure yourself, then gain +3 Magic Damage.
desc_zh:
伤害你自己，
然后获得 +3 魔法伤害。

desc_en: Shoot a lightning bolt that deals 1 damage and knocks the unit it hits 3 tiles in the direction it's facing.
desc_zh:
发射一道闪电，
造成 1 点伤害，
并将命中的单位
沿其朝向击退 3 格。

desc_en: Inflict Burn 1 and +1 [img:spd] to a unit in range.
desc_zh:
对范围内的
一个单位施加 
1 层燃烧和 +1 [img:spd]。

desc_en: A fire spell that increases its range, area, damage, and Burn by 1 every turn.
desc_zh:
一种火焰法术，
每回合其射程、范围、
伤害和燃烧层数增加 1。

desc_en:
An ice spell that increases its range and Slow every turn. At 2 turns, it gains Immobilize 1. At 3 turns, it gains Freeze 1.
[s:.7](Current turns: {v0})[/s]
desc_zh:
一种冰霜法术，
每回合增加其射程和减速层数。
第 2 回合时，获得定身 1。
第 3 回合时，获得冻结 1。
[s:.7]（当前回合：{v0}）[/s]

desc_en: An electric spell that increases its range and damage by 2 every turn, and its stun chance by 10%.
desc_zh:
一种电击法术，
每回合其射程和伤害增加 2，
晕眩几率增加 10%。

desc_en:
This spell gains +1 damage, range and area, and -1 mana cost each time you cast a spell.
This spell resets after you cast it.
desc_zh:
每当你施放法术时，
此法术伤害、射程和
范围 +1，法力消耗 -1。
此法术施放后重置。

desc_en:
Lose Damage equal to half of your basic attack's damage, rounded up. For the rest of the battle, you can attack an extra time each turn.
[s:.7](This can't be cast if your basic attack's damage is 1 or less.)[/s]
desc_zh:
失去等于你基础攻击
伤害一半的伤害（向上取整）。
在战斗剩余时间内，
你每回合可以额外攻击一次。
[s:.7]（如果你的基础攻击伤害为 
1 或更低，则无法施放。）[/s]

desc_en:
Apply Freeze 2 to each unit except for yourself and 1 other chosen unit.
Deal 10 Damage to enemies and heal each ally 10 HP.
There will be permanent consequences for casting this spell…
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
对除你自己和另一个选定单位
以外的每个单位施加冻结 2。
对敌人造成 10 点伤害，
并治疗每个盟友 10 点生命值。
施放此法术将会有永久性后果…
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en:
Drop to 1 HP. Gain mana equal to the HP lost.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
生命值降至 1 点。
获得等同于失去生命值的法力。
[s:.7]（每回合限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: Reduce the cost of another unit's spells by 1 until the end of their turn.
desc_zh:
使另一个单位的法术消耗减少 1，
直到其回合结束。

desc_en: Shoot 3 Magic Missiles at random enemies.
desc_zh: 向随机敌人发射 3 枚魔法飞弹。

desc_en: The next spell you cast is cast twice.
desc_zh: 你施放的下一个法术将施放两次。

desc_en: Your basic attack gains +1 range and area until the end of the turn.
desc_zh:
直到回合结束，
你的基础攻击获得 +1 射程和范围。

desc_en: A Fire / Ice / Electric spell that inflicts Burn 1, Slow 1, and has a 5% chance to inflict Stun.
desc_zh:
一种火焰/冰霜/电击法术，
施加 1 层燃烧、1 层减速，
并有 5% 几率施加晕眩。

desc_en: Heal a unit at range.
desc_zh: 治疗盟友但伤害敌人。

desc_en: Heal an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 治疗盟友但伤害敌人。

desc_en: Inflict Weakness on units in an area.
desc_zh: 对区域内的单位施加虚弱。

desc_en:
A spell that deals more damage the less health the target unit has.
[s:.7](based on their health percent)[/s]
desc_zh:
目标单位生命值越低，
造成的伤害越高的一次法术。
[s:.7](基于其生命值百分比)[/s]

desc_en: Heal units in an area.
desc_zh: 治疗区域内的单位。

desc_en: Inflict Charm 2 on an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 对一名相邻单位施加 2 层魅惑。

desc_en: Remove all debuffs from a unit.
desc_zh:
移除一个单位的
所有减益效果。

desc_en: Remove all buffs from a unit.
desc_zh:
吐在你面前的地块上。
你获得 -1 [img:con] 和 +2 [img:spd]。

desc_en: Inflict Ostracized 2 on a unit.
desc_zh: 对一名单位施加 2 层被排挤。

desc_en: Gain +1 [img:divineshield].
desc_zh: 获得 +1 [img:divineshield]。

desc_en: Give a unit +10 [img:spd] until the end of its next turn.
desc_zh:
直到其下回合结束，
给予一名单位 +10 [img:spd]。

desc_en: Force a unit to attack one of its enemies.
desc_zh: 强迫一名单位攻击其一名敌人。

desc_en: Jump to an open tile next to an ally.
desc_zh: 跳跃至盟友身旁的一个空地块。

desc_en: Jump to an open tile, then heal each adjacent unit.
desc_zh:
跳跃至一个空地块，
然后治疗每名相邻单位。

desc_en: Dash forward, heal a unit and give it a random stat up.
desc_zh:
向前冲刺，
治疗一名单位并给予其
一项随机属性提升。

desc_en: Reverse the last damage an adjacent unit took.
desc_zh:
逆转一名相邻单位
最后受到的伤害。

desc_en: Deal damage to a unit equal to the damage that unit last dealt.
desc_zh:
对一名单位造成的
伤害等于该单位
最后造成的伤害。

desc_en:
Target an area. At the beginning of your next turn, heal all units in that area.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
以一个区域为目标。
在你的下回合开始时，
治疗该区域内的所有单位。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Put a bounty on a unit. When that unit dies, its killer gains All Stats Up.
desc_zh:
对一名单位悬赏。
当该单位死亡时，
其击杀者获得全属性提升。

desc_en: A ranged spell that heals allies and damages enemies.
desc_zh: 远程法术，会治疗友方，伤害敌人。

desc_en: Revive a body to 50% HP and cure one of its injuries.
desc_zh:
将一具尸体复活至 50% 生命值，
并治愈其一处创伤。

desc_en: Heal allies and damage enemies in an area. This spell has half effect outside its center.
desc_zh:
治疗区域内的盟友并伤害敌人。
此法术在中心以外的效果减半。

desc_en: Gain 4 [img:divineshield], 3 [img:shield], heal 2 HP, and Brace 1.
desc_zh:
获得 4 层 [img:divineshield]、3 点 [img:shield]，
恢复 2 点生命值，
并获得 1 层护甲。

desc_en: Revive a body to 100% HP and give it All Stats Up, then you fall asleep.
desc_zh:
将一具尸体复活至 100% 
生命值并给予其全属性提升，
然后你会陷入睡眠。

desc_en: Heal EVERYTHING for 2 HP.
desc_zh: 治疗所有目标 2 点生命值。

desc_en: You and your allies move toward the nearest enemy.
desc_zh:
你和你的盟友向
最近的敌人移动。

desc_en: Spawn a blessing pickup on an empty tile in range.
desc_zh:
在射程内的一个空地块上
生成一个祝福掉落物。

desc_en: Another unit's next spell is free.
desc_zh: 另一个单位的下一个法术免费。

desc_en: Give +2 Diminishing Health Regeneration and +1 to a random stat to an adjacent unit.
desc_zh:
给予一个相邻单位
+2 层生命恢复 (递减)，
并使其随机一项属性 +1。

desc_en: A melee attack that inflicts Blind 5 and Bleed 1.
desc_zh:
造成 5 层致盲
和 1 层流血的近战攻击。

desc_en: Deal holy damage and inflict Blind to everything except for a safe circle around you. This vaporizes units it kills.
desc_zh:
对除你周围安全圈以外的
所有目标造成神圣伤害
并施加致盲。
此攻击会蒸发被杀死的单位。

desc_en:
Heal a unit and remove its debuffs. That unit gets +1 to a random stat and becomes the Alpha.
If there is an Alpha, this spell has infinite range and must target it.
desc_zh:
治疗1个单位，同时清除它的减益。这个单位随机1项属性+1，同时成为头猫。
如果场上已有头猫，那么这个法术范围无限，必须以它为目标。

desc_en:
Give a unit +1 [img:divineshield] and +1 Kinetic Spikes. That unit becomes the Alpha.
If there is an Alpha, this spell costs less and must target it.
desc_zh:
给予一个单位 +1 [img:divineshield] 和 +1 层动能尖刺。
该单位成为首领。
如果场上已有首领，
此法术消耗更少
且必须以首领为目标。

desc_en:
Give a unit +1 Damage. That unit becomes the Alpha.
If there is an Alpha, this spell must target it and it gives +1 bonus attack.
desc_zh:
给予一个单位 +1 伤害。
该单位成为首领。
如果场上已有首领，
此法术必须以首领为目标，
并给予其 +1 次奖励攻击。

desc_en:
Give a unit +1 Bonus Move. That unit becomes the Alpha.
If there is an Alpha, this spell must target it and it gives you +1 Bonus Move too.
desc_zh:
令1个单位获得1次奖励移动。这个单位成为头猫。
如果场上已有头猫，那么这个法术必须以它为目标，同时自身也获得1次奖励移动。

desc_en:
Gain All Stats Up. This spell costs 1 mana less for each HP you healed other units this turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
获得全属性提升。
本回合你每治疗其他单位 1 点 HP，
此法术消耗减少 1 点法力。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en:
A dash attack with range, damage, and knockback equal to the amount of HP you healed other units this turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
射程、伤害和击退距离等于
你本回合治疗其他单位
HP 总量的冲刺攻击。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en:
Swap positions with any unit. That unit becomes the Alpha.
If there is an Alpha, this spell must target it.
desc_zh:
跟场上任一单位交换位置。这个单位成为头猫。
如果场上已有头猫，那么这个法术必须以它为目标。

desc_en: Revive a body to 1 HP.
desc_zh: 将一具尸体复活至 1 点 HP。

desc_en: Heal an adjacent unit 2 to 6 times.
desc_zh: 治疗一个相邻单位 2 到 6 次。

desc_en: Give another unit +5 [img:lck] until the end of its next turn.
desc_zh:
给予另一个单位 +5 [img:lck]，
持续到其下回合结束。

desc_en: Run next to the ally with the most missing health. Trample all in the way.
desc_zh:
跑到生命值缺失最多的盟友身旁。
践踏沿途所有单位。

desc_en:
Make a unit The Alpha.
Bonus Passive: The Alpha has +50% dodge chance.
desc_zh:
使一个单位成为首领。
奖励被动：首领拥有 +50% 闪避率。

desc_en: Heal an adjacent unit. Excess healing is converted to an equal amount of random stat ups.
desc_zh:
治疗一个相邻单位。
溢出的治疗量转化为
等量的随机属性提升。

desc_en: You and adjacent units gain +2 [img:spd].
desc_zh: 你和相邻单位获得 +2 [img:spd]。

desc_en: Inflict Blind 1 on each unit in an area.
desc_zh:
对区域内的每个单位
施加 1 层致盲。

desc_en: Give +1 [img:divineshield] to each unit within 2 tiles of you.
desc_zh:
给予你 2 格范围内的
每个单位 +1 [img:divineshield]。

desc_en: Make an ally move toward you.
desc_zh: 使一个盟友向你移动。

desc_en: You or an adjacent unit gains a random positive effect.
desc_zh:
你或一个相邻单位
获得一个随机正面效果。

desc_en: Force a nearby unit to move away from you.
desc_zh:
强迫一个附近的单位
向远离你的方向移动。

desc_en: You or an adjacent unit gains +1 Health Regeneration.
desc_zh:
你或一个相邻单位
获得 +1 生命恢复。

desc_en: Dash forward one tile and attack.
desc_zh: 向前冲刺一格并攻击。

desc_en: Shoot an energy blast in a straight line.
desc_zh: 直线发射1次能量冲击。

desc_en: Roll up to 4 tiles diagonally.
desc_zh:
向对角线方向
翻滚最多 4 格。

desc_en: Gain [img:str] and [img:dex] equal to your [img:shield] until the end of your turn.
desc_zh:
获得等同于你 [img:shield] 的 [img:str] 和 [img:dex]，
持续到回合结束。

desc_en: Cleanse your debuffs and gain +1 [img:shield].
desc_zh:
净化你的减益效果
并获得 +1 [img:shield]。

desc_en: Throw a random adjacent unit two tiles away, dealing damage to it.
desc_zh:
将一个随机相邻单位
投掷到 2 格外，
对其造成伤害。

desc_en:
Your basic attack inflicts Bruise until the end of the turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
你的基础攻击会施加淤伤，
持续到回合结束。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en:
A melee attack with a high critical hit chance.
RELOAD: Take damage.
desc_zh:
一次拥有高暴击率的近战攻击。
装填：受到伤害。

desc_en:
Dash forward three tiles and attack. This deals 2 damage for each action you've taken this turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
向前冲刺三格并攻击。
本回合你每进行过一次行动，
此技能造成 2 点伤害。
[s:.7](每回合限用一次。)[/s]

desc_en:
Gain +8 [img:shield] and knock back adjacent units two tiles. This spell costs 3 mana less for each action you've taken this turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
获得 +8 [img:shield] 并击退相邻单位两格。
本回合你每进行过一次行动，
此法术的法力消耗减少 3 点。
[s:.7](每回合限用一次。)[/s]

desc_en: A melee attack with Knockback 3. When this hits, switch into ranged stance and refresh your basic attack.
desc_zh:
带有击退 3 效果的近战攻击。
命中时，切换至远程架势
并刷新你的基础攻击。

desc_en: A ranged attack that pulls the unit it hits toward you. When this hits, switch into melee stance and refresh your basic attack.
desc_zh:
一次将命中单位
拉向你的远程攻击。
命中时，切换至近战架势
并刷新你的基础攻击。

desc_en: Gain +20 Movement Range until the end of the turn.
desc_zh:
获得 +20 移动距离
直到回合结束。

desc_en: Jump to a tile. Bounce off any unit you land on, damaging that unit.
desc_zh:
跳跃至一个地块。
若落在单位上则会弹开，
并对其造成伤害。

desc_en: For the rest of the battle, you can attack an extra time each turn.
desc_zh: 本场战斗期间，你每个回合可以额外攻击1次。

desc_en: Gain +2 temporary Brace and +2 temporary Thorns until your next turn.
desc_zh:
获得 +2 临时护甲
和 +2 临时荆棘，
直到你的下一回合。

desc_en: Gain +1 [img:shield]. This spell costs 0 mana the first time you cast it each turn.
desc_zh:
获得 +1 [img:shield]。
每回合第一次施放
此法术时消耗 0 法力。

desc_en: Become downed. You don't get injured. At the end of the next round, you're revived with 1 HP, 15 [img:shield], and All Stats Up.
desc_zh:
进入倒地状态。
你不会受到创伤。
在下一回合结束时，
你将以 1 点生命值、
15 [img:shield] 和全属性提升状态复活。

desc_en: Jump to a tile, then gain +2 [img:shield] for each enemy adjacent to the tile you land on.
desc_zh: 跳到一个方格上，然后前后左右每有1个敌人相邻，就[img:shield]+2。

desc_en: For the rest of the battle, the first spell you cast each turn is cast twice.
desc_zh: 本场战斗期间，你每个回合第一次施放法术会施放两次。

desc_en: Heal yourself for 8 HP and gain +8 Shield, All Stats Up 2, and Sleep 8.
desc_zh:
治疗自身 8 点生命值，
并获得 +8 护盾、
2 层全属性提升和 8 层睡眠。

name_en: Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique
desc_en: A melee attack that causes a unit to die at the end of its next turn. Bosses fall asleep at the end of their next turn instead.
desc_zh:
一次使单位在它的
下一回合结束时死亡的近战攻击。
对 Boss 使用时，
改为在它的下一回合
结束时陷入睡眠。

desc_en: Deal 1 damage and knockback adjacent units. Gain +1 [img:shield].
desc_zh:
造成 1 点伤害并击退相邻单位。
获得 +1 [img:shield]。

desc_en: A magic damage melee attack with knockback 3 that inflicts Confusion.
desc_zh:
一次造成魔法伤害的近战攻击，
造成 3 格击退并施加混乱。

desc_en: For the rest of the battle, you can move an extra time each turn.
desc_zh: 本场战斗期间，你每个回合获得1次奖励移动。

desc_en: Run in a straight line up to 4 tiles, through objects. Wind blows over tiles you run through.
desc_zh:
沿直线奔跑最多 4 格，
穿过物体。风会吹过你经过的地块。

desc_en: Inflict Marked and Magic Weakness 1 on a unit.
desc_zh: 对1个单位施加1层【标记】和1层【魔法克制】。

desc_en: A ten-hit multi-strike melee attack with Knockback 10 at the end of the combo.
desc_zh: 近身10段攻击，最后1段击退10格。

desc_en: Gain +1 temporary Kinetic Spikes.
desc_zh: 获得 +1 临时动能尖刺。

desc_en: A burst of air that knocks back units diagonally from the target.
desc_zh:
一股气流，
将目标对角线方向的单位击退。

desc_en: Gain +1 Brace.
Emit 10 Sparkles.
desc_zh: 释放 10 个火花。

desc_en: A melee attack that does 3 more damage each time you use it on the same turn. This attack inflicts all status effects your basic attack does.
desc_zh:
一次近战攻击，
本回合每使用一次，
伤害增加 3 点。
此攻击会施加你基础攻击
的所有状态效果。

desc_en: Teleport, then use your basic attack on an enemy within range. This spell's range is increased by 2 for each empty armor slot you have.
desc_zh:
传送，
然后对范围内的一个敌人
使用你的基础攻击。
你每有一个空护甲槽，
此法术的射程增加 2。

desc_en: Gain +1 [img:shield] for each empty armor slot you have, then switch stances.
desc_zh:
你每有一个空护甲槽，
便获得 +1 [img:shield]，然后切换架势。

desc_en: Gain +1 [img:dex], and +1 [img:spd]. This spell costs 2 mana less for each empty armor slot you have.
desc_zh:
获得 +1 [img:dex] 和 +1 [img:spd]。
你每有一个空护甲槽，
此法术的法力消耗减少 2 点。

desc_en: A melee attack with knockback that hits two tiles away from you. This spell's range is increased by 1 each time you use it on the same turn.
desc_zh:
一次带有击退效果的近战攻击，
可命中两格远的单位。
本回合每使用一次，
此法术的射程增加 1。

desc_en:
Begin charging a spirit bomb. This ability becomes Throw Spirit Bomb.
Allies gain the bonus ability Donate Energy until you throw it.
desc_zh:
开始蓄力，准备投掷元气弹。这个能力会变成“元气弹投掷”。
投出去之前，友方会获得奖励能力【渡气】。

desc_en:
Throw the Spirit Bomb, then this ability becomes Charge Spirit Bomb.
[s:.7](Cannot be thrown with 0 charges.)[/s]
desc_zh:
投掷元气弹，然后此技能
变为“积蓄元气弹”。
[s:.7](0 层充能时无法投掷。)[/s]

desc_en: Give +1 damage to the Spirit Bomb!
desc_zh: 使元气弹的伤害 +1！

desc_en:
A one-hit kill punch. Gain All Stats Down on use.
This deals 25 damage to bosses instead of killing them.
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
一击必杀的拳击。
使用时获得全属性下降。
对 Boss 造成 25 点
伤害而不是直接击杀。
[s:.7](每场战斗限用一次。)[/s]

desc_en: A weak melee attack that hits an extra time for each empty armor slot you have.
desc_zh:
一次弱近战攻击，
你每有一个空护甲槽，
便额外攻击一次。

desc_en:
Fire a magic blast at a unit within 5 tiles. Requires line of sight.
[s:.7](Castable once per battle. If all your armor slots are empty, castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
对 5 格内的一个单位
发射魔法冲击。需要视线。
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。
如果你的所有护甲槽都为空，
则每回合限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: Move one tile and gain +1 [img:shield].
desc_zh: 移动一格并获得 +1 [img:shield]。

desc_en:
Dash forward X spaces, gain +X [img:shield], deal X damage, and deal X knockback.
X is equal to the number of empty armor slots you have plus one.
desc_zh:
向前冲刺 X 格，
获得 +X [img:shield]，
造成 X 点伤害，
并造成 X 格击退。
X 等于你的空护甲槽数量加一。

desc_en: Summon a 1 HP illusion of yourself within three tiles that mimics your basic attack, but in the opposite direction of you. It dies at the end of your turn.
desc_zh:
在 3 格内召唤一个
拥有 1 点生命值的你的幻象，
它会模仿你的基础攻击，
但方向与你相反。
它会在你的回合结束时死亡。

desc_en: Teleport next to a random enemy, then switch to melee stance and automatically attack it.
desc_zh:
传送至随机敌人身旁，
切换至近战架势并自动攻击它。

desc_en:
Gain +1 [img:int] and +1 [img:shield].
If you have 7 or more [img:shield], this spell costs 1 mana less.
desc_zh:
获得 +1 [img:int] 和 +1 [img:shield]。
如果你拥有 7 层或更多 [img:shield]，
此法术消耗的法力减少 1 点。

desc_en:
You can't cast spells for the rest of the battle.
For the rest of the battle, whenever you kill an enemy, take an extra turn.
desc_zh:
你在本场战斗的剩余时间内
无法施放法术。
在本场战斗的剩余时间内，
每当你击杀一名敌人，
获得一个额外回合。

desc_en: Teleport exactly two tiles away, then switch stances.
desc_zh:
传送到刚好 2 格远的位置，
然后切换架势。

desc_en: Until end of turn, your basic attack emits +1 Sparkle.
desc_zh:
直到回合结束，
你的基础攻击产生 +1 火花。

desc_en: Summon a half-sized copy of yourself with half your stats. It's AI-controlled and can't use spells.
desc_zh: 召唤1个体型减半的自身复制体，属性值是你的一半。它由AI控制，而且不能施放法术。

desc_en: Explode a body and spawn 3 Leeches.
desc_zh: 引爆1具尸体，同时生成3个水蛭。

desc_en: Resurrect a body to half HP. It becomes a Zombie and joins your team.
desc_zh:
将一具尸体以半血复活。
它会变成僵尸并加入你的队伍。

desc_en: Teleport into a body, destroying it to heal 4 HP, gain +1 [img:int] and +1 [img:con].
desc_zh:
传送到一具尸体内，
摧毁它以治疗 4 点生命值，
获得 +1 [img:int] 和 +1 [img:con]。

desc_en: Deal 1 damage to all units.
desc_zh: 对所有单位造成 1 点伤害。

desc_en: Inflict Weakness 5 on a unit.
desc_zh: 对一个单位施加 5 层虚弱。

desc_en: Destroy an adjacent body. The next spell you cast costs 0 mana.
desc_zh: 摧毁前后左右相邻的1具尸体。你接下来施放的1个法术耗费0魔能。

desc_en: Inflict Fear on all enemies.
desc_zh: 对所有敌人施加恐惧。

desc_en: Inflict Soul Link on units in an area.
desc_zh: 对区域内的单位施加灵魂链接。

desc_en: Inflict Soul Link on yourself and every enemy.
desc_zh: 对自己和每个敌人施加灵魂链接。

desc_en: Take 1 damage and heal all allies 1 HP.
desc_zh:
受到 1 点伤害并治疗所有盟
友 1 点生命值。

desc_en: Resurrect an enemy body to full HP. It joins your team.
desc_zh: 令1个敌人的尸体满生命复活。它会加入你的小队。

desc_en: Explode a body, dealing damage and Knockback to adjacent units.
desc_zh:
引爆一具尸体，
对相邻单位造成伤害和击退。

desc_en: Teleport in front of an enemy then Knockback each adjacent unit 4 tiles.
desc_zh:
传送到一个敌人面前，
然后击退每个相邻单位 4 格。

desc_en: Give a unit +1 [img:con] and heal it 4 HP. You gain -1 [img:con] and lose 4 health.
desc_zh:
给予一个单位 +1 [img:con] 并治疗
其 4 点生命值。
你获得 -1 [img:con] 并失去 4 点生命值。

desc_en: Deal 2 damage to yourself.
desc_zh: 对自己造成 2 点伤害。

desc_en: Inflict Fear and Madness on an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 对一个相邻单位施加恐惧和疯狂。

desc_en:
Spawn a shadow copy of yourself that fades after its first turn.
[s:.7](The copy can't cast this ability or give extra turns to units.)[/s]
desc_zh:
生成一个你的暗影分身，
在它的第一回合后消失。
[s:.7](分身无法施放此技能
或给予单位额外回合。)[/s]

desc_en: Teleport to an open tile.
desc_zh: 传送到一个空地块。

desc_en: Inflict Leech 1 on a unit.
desc_zh: 对一个单位施加 1 层水蛭。

desc_en: Inflict Fear 1, Confusion 2, and Madness 2 on units within a cone.
desc_zh:
对锥形范围内的单位施加 1 层恐惧、
2 层混乱和 2 层疯狂。

desc_en: Down yourself.
desc_zh: 让自己倒地。

desc_en: Give Lifesteal 1 to units in an area.
desc_zh: 令1片区域的单位获得1层【吸血】。

desc_en: Dig up a body. It reanimates at the end of the round.
desc_zh:
挖掘一具尸体。
它会在回合结束时复生。

desc_en: Take damage equal to half of your max HP, then deal that much damage and inflict Fear 2 on another unit.
desc_zh:
受到等于你最大生命值一半的伤害，
然后对另一个单位造成等量的
伤害并施加 2 层恐惧。

desc_en:
Down yourself. You don't get injured. Spawn a shadow copy of yourself that fades after its first turn.
[s:.7]The copy can't cast this ability or give extra turns to units.[/s]
desc_zh:
让自己倒地。你不会受伤。
生成一个你的暗影分身，
在它的第一回合后消失。
[s:.7]分身无法施放此技能
或给予单位额外回合。
[/s]

desc_en: Teleport into a familiar and destroy it. Refresh your basic attack.
desc_zh:
传送到一个使魔体内并摧毁它。
刷新你的基础攻击。

desc_en: Summon a skeleton from a body.
desc_zh: 从尸体中召唤一个骷髅。

desc_en: Spend all of your mana, then drain that much HP from an adjacent unit. Ignores shield.
desc_zh:
消耗你所有的法力值，
然后从一个相邻单位
吸取等量的生命值。
无视护盾。

desc_en: Remove all status effects from another unit, then inflict Bleed 5 on it.
desc_zh:
移除另一个单位的所有状态效果，
然后对其施加 5 层流血。

desc_en: Inflict Madness on all enemies.
desc_zh: 对所有敌人施加疯狂。

desc_en: Deal damage and inflict Weakness on an adjacent unit. If you have no weapon, equip a bone.
desc_zh:
对一个相邻单位
造成伤害并施加虚弱。
如果你没有武器，
装备一根骨头。

desc_en: Teleport into a unit with 5 or less health and destroy it.
desc_zh:
传送到一个生命值不高于 5 的
单位体内并摧毁它。

desc_en:
Damage any unit and inflict Fear.
[s:.7]Castable while downed.[/s]
desc_zh:
伤害任意单位并施加恐惧。
[s:.7]倒地时可施放。[/s]

desc_en:
Deal damage to any unit. This has a 25% chance to inflict Fear.
[s:.7]Castable while downed.[/s]
desc_zh:
对任意单位造成伤害。
有 25% 的几率施加恐惧。
[s:.7]倒地时可施放。[/s]

desc_en:
Deal 1 damage and inflict Leech 1.
[s:.7]This spell is stronger and castable while you're downed.[/s]
desc_zh:
造成 1 点伤害并施加 1 层水蛭。
[s:.7]此法术在你倒地时可施放且更强。
[/s]

desc_en:
Deal 1 damage and inflict Leech 1.
[s:.7]This spell is stronger and castable while you're downed.[/s]
desc_zh:
造成1点伤害，同时施加1层【水蛭】。
[s:.7]这个法术效果增强，而且在你倒地期间也能施放。[/s]

desc_en:
Drain 2 HP at melee range.
[s:.7]This spell is much stronger and castable while you're downed. If this kills a unit, revive with 50% hp.[/s]
desc_zh:
于近战范围吸取 2 点生命值。
[s:.7]此法术在你倒地时可施放且更强。
如果击杀单位，以 50% 生命值复活。
[/s]

desc_en:
Drain 2 HP at melee range.
[s:.7]This spell is much stronger and castable while you're downed. If this kills a unit, revive with 50% hp.[/s]
desc_zh:
在近身范围吸取2点生命。
[s:.7]这个法术效果大大增强，而且在你倒地期间也能施放。如果这个法术击杀单位，那么你以50%的生命复活。[/s]

desc_en:
Jump to an open tile in range 2.
[s:.7]This spell is stronger and castable while you're downed. When downed you can land on units dealing damage and inflicting Madness. [/s]
desc_zh:
跳跃至 2 格范围内的空地块。
[s:.7]此法术在倒地时更强且可施放。
倒地时，你可以落在单位上，
造成伤害并施加疯狂效果。[/s]

desc_en:
Jump to an open tile in range 2.
[s:.7]This spell is stronger and castable while you're downed. When downed you can land on units dealing damage and inflicting Madness. [/s]
desc_zh:
跳到方圆2格之内的1个空格。
[s:.7]这个法术效果增强，而且你倒地期间也能施放。你倒地的时候，可以砸在单位身上，造成伤害，同时施加【癫狂】。[/s]

desc_en:
Heal a unit 5 HP, then take 10 damage.
[s:.7]Castable while you're downed. If you do, take no damage and give what you heal All Stats Up.[/s]
desc_zh:
治疗一个单位 5 点生命值，
然后受到 10 点伤害。
[s:.7]倒地时可施放。若如此做，
则不受到伤害，
并赋予治疗目标全属性提升。
[/s]

desc_en:
Heal a unit 5 HP, then take 10 damage.
[s:.7]Castable while you're downed. If you do, take no damage and give what you heal All Stats Up.[/s]
desc_zh:
令1个单位恢复5点生命，然后自己受到10点伤害。
[s:.7]你倒地期间也能施放。如果倒地期间施放，那么你不会受到伤害，而且你治疗的目标所有属性提升。[/s]

desc_en:
Spawn a ghost Familiar that fades after its first turn.
[s:.7]Castable while you're downed. If you do, spawn a shadow copy of yourself instead.[/s]
desc_zh:
生成一个在首回合后
消失的幽灵使魔。
[s:.7]倒地时可施放。若如此做，
改为生成一个你自己的暗影分身。
[/s]

desc_en:
Spawn a ghost Familiar that fades after its first turn.
[s:.7]Castable while you're downed. If you do, spawn a shadow copy of yourself instead.[/s]
desc_zh:
生成1个鬼魂跟班，会在它的第一个回合后消失。
[s:.7]你倒地期间也能施放。如果倒地期间施放，改为生成你的1个影子分身。[/s]

desc_en: Until your next turn, you won't get injured if you're downed.
desc_zh:
直到你的下回合，
若你处于倒地状态，
不会受到创伤。

desc_en:
Injure yourself and take an extra turn.
[s:.7](This spell can't be cast on extra turns.)[/s]
desc_zh:
使自己受到创伤并获得额外回合。
[s:.7]（此法术无法在额外回合中施放。）[/s]

desc_en: Give a unit -4 [img:lck].
desc_zh: 赋予一个单位 -4 [img:lck]。

desc_en: Inflict Leech 3 on all units, except yourself.
desc_zh: 对除你自己外的所有单位施加 3 层水蛭。

desc_en: Destroy an adjacent body. Your basic attack inflicts +1 Leech for the rest of the battle.
desc_zh:
销毁一具相邻的尸体。在剩余战斗中，
你的基础攻击施加 +1 水蛭。

desc_en: Inflict Sleep 1 on an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 对一个相邻单位施加 1 层睡眠。

desc_en: Teleport to an open tile in range 1. Whenever a unit dies, this spell's range increases by 1.
desc_zh:
传送至 1 格范围内的空地块。
每当有单位死亡，
此法术的射程增加 1。

desc_en:
Inflict Weakness 5, Poison 2, and Madness 2 on all enemies.
There are permanent consequences for casting this spell… but maybe not for you. 
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
对所有敌人施加 5 层虚弱、
2 层中毒和 2 层疯狂。
施放此法术会有永久性后果……
但也许不是对你。
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en:
You and all allies lose 7 HP. Summon a flesh golem with one random spell from each of those units.
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
你和所有盟友失去 7 点生命值。
召唤一个血肉魔像，
它拥有来自这些单位各一个随机法术。
[s:.7]（每场战斗限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en:
Swap HP with an ally in range 3.
[s:.7]Castable while you're downed. If this spell downs you or the ally, neither are injured.[/s]
desc_zh:
与 3 格范围内的一个盟友交换生命值。
[s:.7]倒地时可施放。
若此法术导致你或盟友倒地，
双方都不会受到创伤。[/s]

desc_en:
Swap HP with an ally in range 3.
[s:.7]Castable while you're downed. If this spell downs you or the ally, neither are injured.[/s]
desc_zh:
跟方圆3格之内1个友方对调生命。
[s:.7]你倒地期间也能施放。即使这个法术令你或友方倒地，你们也不会落下伤残。[/s]

desc_en:
Down an ally in range 5 and steal their mana. It doesn't get injured.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
击倒 5 格范围内的
一个盟友并偷取其法力值。
该盟友不会受到创伤。
[s:.7]（每回合限施放一次。）[/s]

desc_en: Dig to any tile and unearth a body.
desc_zh: 挖掘至任意地块并掘出一具尸体。

desc_en: Dig to any tile and unearth 4 zombies.
desc_zh: 挖掘至任意地块并掘出 4 个僵尸。

desc_en: Inflict Infested 1 on a unit in range 3.
desc_zh:
对 3 格范围内的
一个单位施加 1 层寄生。

desc_en: Surround a unit with leeches.
desc_zh: 用水蛭包围一个单位。

desc_en: Push a unit within your line of sight away from you 10 tiles.
desc_zh:
将你视线内的一个单位
推离你 10 个地块。

desc_en: Cause an enemy within your line of sight to attack another enemy if it can.
desc_zh:
使你视线内的一个敌人
攻击另一个敌人（如果可以）。

desc_en: Charm an enemy within your line of sight for the rest of the battle.
desc_zh:
魅惑你视线内的一个敌人，
持续至战斗结束。

desc_en: Damage and throw each unit near you to random tiles.
desc_zh:

desc_en: Teleport exactly three tiles away.
desc_zh: 传送至正好 3 个地块远的位置。

desc_en: Pull units toward a tile within range 5.
desc_zh: 将单位拉向射程 5 内的一个地块。

desc_en: Push away each unit near you. This inflicts Madness and has a small chance to inflict Stun.
desc_zh:
推开你附近的每个单位。
施加疯狂，并有小几率施加晕眩。

desc_en: Deal damage to and inflict Bruise on a unit within your line of sight.
desc_zh:
对你视线内的一个单位

desc_en: Create floating glass shards on a tile within your line of sight.
desc_zh:

生成浮空玻璃碎片。

desc_en: Deal damage to and inflict Blind on every unit within your line of sight.
desc_zh:
对你视线内的每个单位
造成伤害并施加致盲。

desc_en: Replace your spells with the spells of an ally cat until the end of the turn.
desc_zh:
直到回合结束前，
将你的法术替换为
一只盟友猫咪的法术。

desc_en: Spend all your mana. Give a unit within your line of sight a random stat up for every 3 mana spent (rounded up). Give enemies random stat downs instead.

消耗你所有的法力。
每消耗 3 点法力（向上取整），
赋予你视线内的一个单位
一项随机属性提升。
若对敌人使用，
则改为赋予随机属性下降。

desc_en: Teleport two tiles away. Displace any units you teleport into.
desc_zh:
传送至 2 个地块远的位置。
置换你传送位置上的任何单位。

desc_en:
Give another unit an extra turn after this one.
This spell can't be cast during extra turns.
desc_zh:
使另一个单位在本回合
结束后获得一个额外回合。
此法术无法在额外回合中施放。

desc_en: Teleport all enemies within an area as close to the center of that area as possible.
desc_zh: 把1片区域之内的敌人全部尽可能传送到区域中心的附近。

desc_en: Gain +1 [img:int] and -1 [img:cha].
desc_zh: 获得 +1 [img:int] 和 -1 [img:cha] 。

desc_en:
Deal 1 damage to any unit within your line of sight.
RELOAD: Spend mana
desc_zh:
对你视线内的任意单位
造成 1 点伤害。
装填：消耗法力

desc_en: Teleport to any tile. At the end of your turn, teleport back to your original tile and deal 10 damage to any unit you teleport into.
desc_zh:
传送至任意地块。
回合结束时，
传送回你的原位置，
并对你传送位置上的
任何单位造成 10 点伤害。

desc_en: Teleport back.
desc_zh: 传送回去。

desc_en: Force a unit within your line of sight to move and attack one of its enemies.
desc_zh:
强迫你视线内的一个单位

desc_en: Give a unit within your line of sight +3 temporary Bleed Thorns until the end of its turn.

desc_en: Inflict Madness on a unit in your line of sight.
desc_zh: 对视线内的一名单位施加疯狂。

desc_zh:

每个单位施加 2 层致盲。

desc_en: Collect any pickup within your line of sight.
desc_zh: 收集视线内的任意掉落物。

desc_en: A unit within your line of sight backflips out of the way the next time they're targeted by an enemy.
desc_zh:
视线内的一名单位下一次被敌人作为目标时，
会后空翻闪避。

desc_en: Inflict Mana Leech 2 and Weakness 2 on all units within 3 tiles of you.
desc_zh:
对你周围 3 格内的所有单位
施加 2 层法力水蛭和 2 层虚弱。

desc_en: Vaporize everything on a tile within your line of sight. Against a boss, this deals 10 damage and inflicts Stun instead.
desc_zh:
蒸发视线内某地块上的所有东西。
对 Boss 使用时，
改为造成 10 点伤害并施加晕眩。

desc_en: Every ally that hasn't taken their turn yet takes their turn right after yours. You go first next round.
desc_zh:
所有尚未行动的盟友
将在你之后立即行动。
你将在下一回合率先行动。

desc_en: Upgrade one of your spells at random for the rest of the battle.
desc_zh:
在本场战斗的剩余时间内，
随机升级你的一个法术。

desc_en: Deal damage to a unit in your line of sight, then increase this spell's damage by 1 for the rest of the battle.
desc_zh:
对视线内的一名单位造成伤害，
并在本场战斗的剩余时间内，
使此法术的伤害增加 1 点。

desc_en: Spawn a friendly illusion of a random unit that fades away after one turn.
desc_zh:
生成一个随机单位的友方幻象，
该幻象在一回合后消散。

desc_en: Every enemy in your line of sight takes an extra turn. They are charmed on that turn.
desc_zh:
视线内的所有敌人
获得一个额外回合。
它们在该回合中处于魅惑状态。

desc_en:
Take an extra turn. You're stunned and don't regenerate mana on that turn.
[s:.7](This spell can't be cast on extra turns.)[/s]
desc_zh:
获得1个额外回合。你在那个回合处于【眩晕】状态，而且不会恢复魔能。
[s:.7]（这个法术不能在额外回合施放）[/s]

desc_en: Inflict Magic Weakness 2 on all units in your line of sight.
desc_zh:
对视线内所有单位
施加 2 层魔法弱点。

desc_en:
Revive all bodies, fully heal all units, and clear all status effects.
[s:.7](This spell can be cast only once per battle.)[/s]

复活所有尸体，
完全治愈所有单位，
并清除所有状态效果。
[s:.7](此法术每场战斗只能施放一次。)[/s]

desc_zh:
以视线内的一只盟友猫咪为目标。

让一颗小行星坠落到

desc_en: Inflict Freeze on a unit within your line of sight.
desc_zh: 对视线内的一名单位施加冻结。

desc_en:
Give a unit within your line of sight an extra turn immediately, then end your turn.

desc_zh: 把前后左右相邻的单位击退10格。如果你这时是满魔能，那么被击退的单位发生碰撞时会受到10点伤害。

desc_en: Inflict Slow 1 on a unit within your line of sight. If you cast this from full mana, instead inflict Immobilize 1 and deal 6 damage.
desc_zh:

desc_zh:

desc_zh:
将你附近某个区域内
的单位击退 4 格。

desc_en: A melee attack with Lifesteal.
desc_zh: 带有生命偷取的近战攻击。

desc_en: Knock a unit back 10 tiles.
desc_zh: 将一个单位击退 10 格。

desc_en: A melee attack that Immobilizes.
desc_zh: 施加定身的近战攻击。

desc_en: Grab a unit in front of you and slam it into the tile behind you.
desc_zh:
抓住前方的一个单位，
将其摔到你身后的地块上。

desc_en: Inflict Fear on an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 对一个相邻单位施加恐惧。

desc_en: Throw an adjacent unit to an open tile.
desc_zh:
将一个相邻单位
投掷到一个空地块上。

desc_en:
Throw an adjacent unit to an open tile.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
把前后左右相邻的1个单位扔到空格。
[s:.7]（每个回合可以施放1次）[/s]

desc_en:
Throw your crippled friend to any tile.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
将你残疾的朋友
投掷到任意地块。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Jump to a tile and Immobilize anything you land on.
desc_zh:
跳跃到一个地块，
并对你落点上的
任何目标施加定身。

desc_en: Jump to a tile and damage what you land on.
desc_zh: 跳到其他方格，对你砸到的东西造成伤害。

desc_en: Jump to a tile and damage what you land on.
desc_zh: 跳到其他方格，对你砸到的东西造成伤害。

desc_en: Dash forward with Trample, then spawn a rock.
desc_zh: 向前横冲直撞突进，然后生成1块石头。

desc_en: Swap positions with any ally.
desc_zh: 与任意盟友交换位置。

desc_en: Jump to a tile adjacent to an ally. Damage and displace any units you land on.
desc_zh:
跳跃到盟友相邻的地块。
对你落点上的任何单位
造成伤害并置换。

desc_en: Hit all adjacent units, then spawn a rock.
desc_zh:
攻击所有相邻单位，
然后生成一块岩石。

desc_en:
Deal damage in a cone with a 10% chance to Petrify. Has a chance to spawn rocks.
[s:.7](This spell spawns rocks.)[/s]
desc_zh:
在锥形范围内造成伤害，
有 10% 几率施加石化。
有几率生成岩石。
[s:.7](此法术会生成岩石。)[/s]

desc_en: Throw a rock with a 10% chance to Stun.
desc_zh:
投掷一块岩石，
有 10% 几率施加晕眩。

desc_en:
Give a unit +5 Thorns until your next turn.
[s:.7](You can target yourself.)[/s]
desc_zh:
给予一个单位 +5 荆棘
直到你的下一回合。
[s:.7](你可以以自己为目标。)[/s]

desc_en: Force an enemy to move towards you.
desc_zh: 强迫1个敌人朝你的方向移动。

desc_en: Trample over one tile diagonally.
desc_zh: 沿对角线践踏经过一个地块。

desc_en: Knock 2 enemies in front of you together.
desc_zh: 将你面前的 2 个敌人撞在一起。

desc_en: Levitate all rocks. They will automatically fling towards enemies that end movement in line with them.
desc_zh: 令所有石头浮空。敌人移动结束时，如果跟浮空的石头在一条直线上，那么石头会自动砸过去。

desc_en: Jump on top of a rock, exploding it. Deal damage and knock back all adjacent units.
desc_zh:
跳到一块岩石上
并将其引爆。
对所有相邻单位
造成伤害并击退。

desc_en: The next time an ally is targeted by an enemy, switch places with that ally.
desc_zh:
下次有盟友被敌人选中为目标时，
与该盟友交换位置。

desc_en: {he} swap
desc_zh: {he}交换位置

desc_en: Dash 3 tiles, damage, inflict Bruise and throw what you hit towards your original tile.
desc_zh:
冲刺 3 格，造成伤害，
施加淤伤，
并将你撞到的目标
投掷向你原来的地块。

desc_en: Shoot a rock forward.
desc_zh: 向前发射一块岩石。

desc_en: Damage and Petrify a unit within 3 tiles of you.
desc_zh:
对你 3 格范围内的
一个单位造成伤害并石化。

desc_en: Pull a unit within 2 tiles towards you, knocking it into you.
desc_zh: 把周围2格之内的1个单位拉到自己身边，令它撞在你身上。

desc_en: Pull all units in a wide line towards the center of that line. This has a 10% chance to Petrify.
desc_zh:
将宽直线范围内的
所有单位拉向该直线中心。
这有 10% 几率施加石化。

desc_en: Drop a boulder on an adjacent tile, damaging and displacing units it lands on.
desc_zh:
在相邻地块上投下一块巨石，
对落点上的单位造成伤害和置换。

desc_en:
Jump up to 3 tiles away, damage units you land on, then gain -1 [img:spd].
[s:.7](This spell's mana cost is equal to your [img:spd].
At 0 [img:spd], this spell is Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
跳跃至最远 3 格外，
对落点单位造成伤害，
然后获得 -1 [img:spd]。
[s:.7](此法术的法力消耗等于你的 [img:spd]。
在 0 [img:spd] 时，此法术每回合限施放一次。
)[/s]

desc_en:
Dash forward one tile and attack with Knockback.
This spell uses up your movement action.
desc_zh:
向前冲刺一格
并进行带有击退的攻击。
此法术会消耗你的移动行动。

desc_en:
Push a unit back 1 tile.
[s:.7](This spell costs 0 mana the first time it's used each turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
将一个单位推后 1 格。
[s:.7](每回合首次使用此法术
消耗 0 法力。)[/s]

desc_en: Inflict Petrify on the first unit in a line.
desc_zh: 对1条直线上的第一个单位施加【石化】。

desc_en: Inflict Petrify on all units in your line of sight.
desc_zh: 对视线内的所有单位施加石化。

desc_en: Gain +4 Brace until the next time you move.
desc_zh:
获得 +4 护甲，
直到你下次移动为止。

desc_en: Eat a rock to gain +5 [img:shield] and +1 [img:str].
desc_zh: 吞下一块岩石，获得 +5 [img:shield] 和 +1 [img:str]。

desc_en:
Gain +5 [img:shield] and -1 [img:spd]. 
If you are at 0 [img:spd], instead cleanse all of your debuffs.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
获得 +5 [img:shield] 和 -1 [img:spd]。
如果你当前的 [img:spd] 为 0，
则驱散你所有的减益效果。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Dash forward up to 3 tiles, gain +4 [img:shield] then damage and knock back adjacent units.
desc_zh:
向前冲刺最多 3 个地块，
获得 +4 [img:shield]，
然后对相邻单位造成伤害
并将其击退。

desc_en: Toss a unit to an empty tile within 3 tiles of you, then your allies attack it if they can.
desc_zh:
将一个单位投掷到
你周围 3 个地块内的
空地块上，然后你的
盟友会尽可能攻击它。

desc_en: All units on dirt tiles get tossed to random nearby tiles and take damage when they land.
desc_zh:
所有位于泥土地块上的
单位会被投掷到附近的随机地块上，
并在落地时受到伤害。

desc_en: Gain +99 Brace until your next turn, then disable this spell until you take a total of 25 damage.
desc_zh:
获得 +99 护甲直到
你的下一回合，
并在你累计受到 
25 点伤害之前禁用此法术。

desc_en: Fling all units in a straight line onto nearby tiles.
desc_zh:
将一条直线上的所有单位
抛到附近的地块上。

desc_en: Turn a tile into a dirt tile, smashing any inanimate objects into rocks.
desc_zh:
将一个地块变为泥土地块，
将任何无生命物体粉碎为岩石。

desc_en:
Get flung to a tile and deal damage to anything you land on.
This doesn't use up your movement action.
desc_zh:
把自己甩到其他方格，同时对你砸到的东西造成伤害。
这个能力不会耗费你的移动行动。

desc_en: Trample over 2 tiles in a straight line destroying any inanimate objects.
desc_zh:
沿直线践踏穿过 2 个地块，
摧毁任何无生命物体。

desc_en:
Gain +3 Thorns. 
This spell uses up your movement action.
desc_zh:
【尖刺】+3。
这个法术会耗尽你的移动行动。

desc_en:
Heal 15 HP and gain -2 [img:spd].
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
治疗 15 点生命值并获得 -2 [img:spd]。
[s:.7](每场战斗限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Deal damage equal to your [img:con] and inflict Stun. Also stuns yourself.
desc_zh:
造成等同于你 [img:con] 的伤害并施加晕眩。
同时晕眩你自己。

desc_en:
Start a sandstorm.
(Sandstorm deals 1 damage to all units at the end of round.)
If a sandstorm was already active, increase its damage by 1.
desc_zh:
引发沙尘暴。
（沙尘暴在回合结束时对所有单
位造成 1 点伤害。）
如果沙尘暴已经生效，
则使其伤害增加 1 点。

desc_en: Gain +1 knockback damage and +1 knockback range until the end of the turn.
desc_zh:
直到回合结束，
获得 +1 击退伤害和 +1 击退距离。

desc_en: Attack an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 攻击前后左右相邻的1个单位。

desc_en: Attack an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 攻击前后左右相邻的1个单位。

desc_en: Attack an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 攻击前后左右相邻的1个单位。

desc_en: Attack an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 攻击前后左右相邻的1个单位。

desc_en: A melee attack that can only hit from behind. This attack ignores shield and has 50% crit chance.
desc_zh:
只能从背后命中的近战攻击。
此攻击无视护盾并拥有 50% 暴击率。

desc_en: Until end of turn, your backstabs do +75% more damage and ignore shield.
desc_zh:
直到回合结束，
你的背刺造成的伤害
增加 75% 并无视护盾。

desc_en: Inflict Poison 2 on all units adjacent to you.
desc_zh: 对所有相邻单位施加 2 层中毒。

desc_en: Throw a nail that inflicts Poison and ignores shield.
desc_zh:
投掷一枚钉子，
施加中毒并无视护盾。

desc_en: Throw a nail that inflicts Weakness and ignores shield.
desc_zh:
投掷一枚钉子，
施加虚弱并无视护盾。

desc_en: Throw a nail that inflicts Bleed and ignores shield.
desc_zh:
投掷一枚钉子，
施加流血并无视护盾。

desc_en:
Throw a coin that deals damage.
RELOAD: Collect a coin.
[s:.7]This spell costs more mana each additional time you use it on the same turn.[/s]
desc_zh:
投掷一枚造成伤害的硬币。
装填：收集一枚金币。
[s:.7]在同一回合内每额外使用一次，
此法术的法力消耗就会增加。[/s]

desc_en: Refresh your movement action.
desc_zh: 刷新你的移动行动。

desc_en: Refresh your basic attack.
desc_zh: 令你的普通攻击刷新。

desc_en: Gain Stealth.
desc_zh: 获得【隐匿】。

desc_en:
Teleport behind a unit.
[s:.7]Nothin' personnel, kid.[/s]
desc_zh:
传送到一个单位身后。
[s:.7]别介意，小子。[/s]

desc_en:
Take an extra turn at the end of the round.
[s:.7](This spell can't be cast on extra turns.)[/s]
desc_zh:
在回合结束时进行一个额外回合。
[s:.7](此法术不能在额外回合中施放。)[/s]

desc_en: Make a unit face away from you.
desc_zh: 使一个单位背对你。

desc_en: A melee attack that rebounds you backwards 10 tiles.
desc_zh:
一次近战攻击，
并将你向后弹开 10 格。

desc_en: Throw a nail that knocks coins out of units it hits and ignores shield.
desc_zh:
投掷一枚钉子，
将击中单位的金币打落并无视护盾。

desc_en: Spawn 2-3 coins on random tiles.
desc_zh: 在随机地块上生成 2-3 枚金币。

desc_en: Steal 1-3 coins from a unit and give it -1 Damage.
desc_zh:
从一个单位身上偷取 1-3 枚金币，
并使其获得 -1 伤害。

desc_en: Backflip out of the way the next time you're targeted by an enemy.
desc_zh:
下次被敌人设为目标时，
后空翻闪避。

desc_en:
Gain +10% dodge chance.
Disable this spell if you have more than 65% dodge chance.
desc_zh:
获得 +10% 闪避率。
如果你拥有超过 65% 闪避率，
此法术失效。

desc_en: Teleport to a tile with coins on it.
desc_zh: 传送到一个有金币的地块上。

desc_en:
Target any enemy. Teleport behind it at the start of your next turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
以任意敌人为目标。
在你的下个回合开始时
传送到它身后。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Throw 10 1-damage nails that ignore shield.
desc_zh:
投掷 10 枚造成 1 点伤害
且无视护盾的钉子。

desc_en: A melee attack that inflicts -1 Damage and Bleed.
desc_zh:
一次施加 -1 伤害和流血
的近战攻击。

desc_en:
Roll in a straight line up to three tiles.
RELOAD: Backstab a unit.
desc_zh:
沿直线翻滚最多 3 格。
装填：背刺一个单位。

desc_en: A melee attack that has all effects of your basic attack and ignores shield.
desc_zh:
一次具有你基础攻击
所有效果并无视护盾的
近战攻击。

desc_en: Inflict Blind on all units in a small cone.
desc_zh:
对小锥形范围内的
所有单位施加致盲。

desc_en: Inflict Poison 4 on an adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 对相邻单位施加 4 层中毒。

desc_en:
Teleport exactly 2 tiles away, leaving behind a shadow that mimics your basic attack.
[s:.7](The shadow fades at the end of your turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
传送至刚好 2 格远的位置，
留下一个模仿你基础攻击的暗影。
[s:.7](暗影会在回合结束时消失。)[/s]

desc_en:
Spawn a shadow up to 3 tiles away that mimics your basic attack.
[s:.7](The shadow fades at the end of your turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
在最多 3 格远的位置生成一个
模仿你基础攻击的暗影。
[s:.7](暗影会在回合结束时消失。)[/s]

desc_en: Move up to 4 tiles, spreading glass shards on the tiles you walk through.
desc_zh:
移动最多 4 格，
在经过的地块上撒布玻璃碎片。

desc_en: Throw a nail that passes through units and ignores shield.
desc_zh: 掷出一枚钉子，穿透单位并无视护盾。

desc_en: Gain temporary +5 [img:lck] until your next turn.
desc_zh:
获得临时 +5 [img:lck] 
直到你的下一回合。

desc_en: Throw a nail that inflicts Poison 1 and ignores shield at each enemy in your line of sight.
desc_zh:
向视线内的每个敌人掷出一枚钉子，
施加 1 层中毒并无视护盾。

desc_en:
Loot 1-3 coins from a body... and possibly something else?
[s:.7](This might destroy the body)[/s]
desc_zh:
从尸体上搜刮 1-3 枚金币...
可能还有别的东西？
[s:.7](这可能会摧毁尸体)[/s]

desc_en: A weak melee attack. If this crits, inflict Bleed 5.
desc_zh:
一次微弱的近战攻击。如果暴击，
施加 5 层流血。

desc_en: Gain Stealth 1.
desc_zh: 获得 1 层潜行。

desc_en: Gain +1 [img:dex] and +1 Range until the end of the battle.
desc_zh:
获得 +1 [img:dex] 和 
+1 射程直到战斗结束。

desc_en: Teleport directly behind a random enemy.
desc_zh: 传送到一个随机敌人正后方。

desc_en: An attack that hits 2 times from behind.
desc_zh: 从身后攻击2次。

desc_en: A melee attack with increased critical hit chance. If this crits and your trinket slot is empty, gain a kidney, then inflict Bleed 1.
desc_zh:
一次暴击率增加的近战攻击。
如果暴击且你的饰品槽为空，
获得一个肾脏，
然后施加 1 层流血。

desc_en: A weak melee attack. If this crits, inflict -1 [img:lck] and you gain +1 [img:lck].
desc_zh:
一次微弱的近战攻击。
如果暴击，施加 -1 [img:lck] 
且你获得 +1 [img:lck]。

desc_en:
Swap positions with an ally. Swap back at the end of your turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
与一名盟友交换位置。
回合结束时换回。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Gain +2 Range. Your attacks pass through units and ignore shield for the rest of the turn.
desc_zh:
获得 +2 射程。
本回合你的攻击
穿透单位并无视护盾。

desc_en: Gain +1 Range for the rest of the turn.
desc_zh: 本回合获得 +1 射程。

desc_en: Throw 3 nails straight and diagonally in front of you. These nails have the effects of your basic attack and ignore shield.
desc_zh:
向你前方直线和
对角线方向掷出 3 枚钉子。
这些钉子具有你基础攻击
的效果并无视护盾。

desc_en:
Destroy an adjacent body. Enemies won't attack you until your next turn.
[s:.7](Castable once per turn.)[/s]
desc_zh:
摧毁一具相邻的尸体。
直到你的下一回合，
敌人不会攻击你。
[s:.7](每回合限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Throw a projectile that passes through units and then returns to you. This can collect pickups.
desc_zh:
掷出一个穿透单位然后
返回你手中的投射物。
这可以收集掉落物。

desc_en: Inflict Confusion 1 on each adjacent unit.
desc_zh: 对每个相邻单位施加 1 层混乱。

desc_en: A melee attack. If this crits, refresh your basic attack and movement actions.
desc_zh:
一次近战攻击。如果暴击，
刷新你的基础攻击和移动行动。

desc_en: Teleport to a tile on the edge of the map.
desc_zh: 传送到地图边缘的一个地块。

desc_en:
Spend all your mana. For every 5 mana spent, your basic attack inflicts +1 Poison.
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
消耗你所有的法力。
每消耗 5 点法力，
你的基础攻击施加 +1 中毒。
[s:.7](每场战斗限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Collect an adjacent pickup and gain +2 [img:lck] instead of its normal effects.
desc_zh:
收集一个相邻的掉落物，
获得 +2 [img:lck]，
而非其正常效果。

desc_en: {he} jump
desc_zh: {he}跳

desc_en: Gain +1 Tech.
desc_zh: 获得 +1 科技。

desc_en: Spend all of your mana, then deal that much electric damage to an adjacent unit.
desc_zh:
消耗所有法力值，
然后对一名相邻单位
造成等量的电击伤害。

desc_en: Repair 1 use to all of your or an adjacent unit's equipment.
desc_zh:
修复你自己或一名
相邻单位所有装备的
 1 次使用次数。

desc_en: Fly to a random tile in a large area. If you land on a unit, explode dealing 5 damage in an area (including to yourself).
desc_zh:
飞向大范围内的随机地块。
如果落在单位上，
则爆炸并对区域内（包括你自己
）造成 5 点伤害。

desc_en: Spawn a decoy that explodes when it dies.
desc_zh: 生成一个在死亡时会爆炸的诱饵。

desc_en: Your next attack breaks your weapon, then craft a new one.
desc_zh:
你的下一次攻击会破坏你的武器，
然后制作一把新武器。

desc_en: Jump up to 2 tiles away.
desc_zh: 跳跃至最多 2 格远的地方。

desc_en: Shoot a flame that inflicts Burn.
desc_zh: 发射火焰，施加燃烧效果。

desc_en: Take an extra turn after this one. You are AI controlled on that turn.
desc_zh:
在原本回合结束后获得额外回合。
你在该回合中由 AI 控制。

desc_en: Destroy your weapon to gain +1 Tech and refresh your basic action.
desc_zh:
摧毁你的武器以获得 
+1 科技并刷新你的
基础行动。

desc_en: Summon a turret.
desc_zh: 召唤一个炮塔。

desc_en: Dash forward in a straight line then explode dealing damage in an area (including to yourself).
desc_zh:
向前方直线冲刺，
然后爆炸对区域内
（包括你自己）造成伤害。

desc_en: Dash forward in a straight line then explode.
desc_zh: 沿直线突进，然后爆炸。

desc_en: Dig to an open tile in a straight line.
desc_zh: 直线挖掘到一个空地块。

desc_en: Craft a Tinkerer armor piece into one of your empty armor slots.
desc_zh:
制作一件工匠护甲部件
并放入你的一个空护甲槽中。

desc_en: Gain +7 [img:shield] and Burn 3.
desc_zh: 获得 +7 [img:shield] 和 3 层燃烧。

desc_en: Summon a nail that arcs electricity to neighboring tiles whenever any unit spends mana.
desc_zh:
召唤一枚钉子，
当任何单位消耗法力值时，
它会向邻近地块释放电弧。

desc_en: Craft and equip a random temporary weapon.
desc_zh: 制作并装备一把随机临时武器。

desc_en: Deal damage to all units. The closer a unit is to you the more damage it takes.
desc_zh:
对所有单位造成伤害。
单位离你越近，
受到的伤害越高。

desc_en: Deal 1 damage to a unit for each unique divisor in its current HP value. If its HP was a prime number, stun it.
desc_zh:
单位的当前生命值
每有一个唯一因数，
就对其造成 1 点伤害。
如果其生命值是质数，就晕眩它。

desc_en: Conjure a random spell of your class as a bonus ability.
desc_zh:
召唤一个你职业的
随机法术作为额外技能。

desc_en: Gain +1 to a random stat.
desc_zh: 随机属性 +1。

desc_en:
Spawn a Catbot and give it your current weapon.
[s:.7](You will not get the weapon back)[/s]
desc_zh:
生成一个猫机器人
并把你的当前武器给它。
[s:.7]（你将不会拿回该武器）[/s]

desc_en: Spawn a Bombchu bot.
desc_zh: 生成一个炸弹鼠机器人。

desc_en: Explode a familiar, dealing 5 damage with knockback in an area.
desc_zh:
引爆一个使魔，
在区域内造成 5 点伤害
并产生击退效果。

desc_en: Deal 1 electric damage with a random amount of knockback (up to 3) to all adjacent units.
desc_zh:
对所有相邻单位造成 1 点电
击伤害和随机距离（最多 3）的击退。

desc_en: Give your weapon +3 electric damage.
desc_zh: 给你的武器 +3 电击伤害。

desc_en: Explode and fly to a random tile at least four tiles away. This explosion damages you.
desc_zh:
爆炸并飞向至少 
4 格远的随机地块。
这次爆炸会对你造成伤害。

desc_en: Throw 3 small 1-damage explosives at random tiles in an area.
desc_zh:
向区域内的
随机地块投掷 3 个造成 1 点伤害的
小型爆炸物。

desc_en: Fully heal a familiar and give it All Stats Up.
desc_zh:
完全治愈一个使魔
并赋予其全属性提升。

desc_en:
Gain +3 Tech and Madness 1.
[s:.7](This spell can only be cast once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
获得 +3 科技和 1 层疯狂。
[s:.7](此法术每场战斗只能施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Spawn a Rubber Fist Bot.
desc_zh: 生成一个橡胶拳机器人。

desc_en: Refresh your weapon and trinket actions (unless they gain you mana).
desc_zh:
刷新你的
武器和饰品行动
（除非它们能为你获得法力）。

desc_en: Dash-punch with Knockback 3.
desc_zh: 突进拳击，击退3格。

desc_en: Launch yourself out of the mech. Deal damage to units you land on and yourself.
desc_zh:
将自己从机甲中弹射出去。
对你落点处的单位
和你自己造成伤害。

desc_en: Fire the machine guns!
desc_zh: 机枪开火！

desc_en: Dash forward and light fires in your path.
desc_zh: 向前突进，在你走过的方格点火。

desc_en:
Summon a mech suit that can be piloted.
[s:.7](Castable once per battle.)[/s]
desc_zh:
召唤一套可驾驶的机甲套装。
[s:.7](每场战斗限施放一次。)[/s]

desc_en: Gain +6 [img:shield] and +1 temporary Brace. This spell has a 75% chance to be disabled on each turn.
desc_zh:
获得 +6 [img:shield] 和 +1 临时护甲。
此法术每回合有 75% 几率失效。

desc_en: Shoot an explosive homing missile at a random enemy. This spell has a 75% chance to be disabled on each turn.
desc_zh:
向随机敌人发射一枚爆炸追踪导弹。
此法术每回合有 75% 几率失效。

desc_en: Destroy your weapon and gain one of the following: +2 [img:shield], +4 Charge, +1 Thorns, or 1 coin.
desc_zh:
摧毁你的武器并获得以下效果之一：
+2 [img:shield]，+4 充能，+1 荆棘，
或 1 金币。

desc_en:
Deal 50 damage to and inflict Burn 10 on all enemies. You can pay for this spell over multiple turns.
[s:.7](This spell's mana cost can't be modified.)[/s]
desc_zh:
对所有敌人造成50点伤害，同时施加10层【灼烧】。这个法术的魔能耗费可以分摊到多个回合。
[s:.7]（这个法术的魔能耗费不会改变。）[/s]

desc_en: Teleport to any tile. You have a 15% chance to equip a piece of Fly armor that breaks any armor pieces it replaces.
desc_zh:
传送至任意地块。
你有 15% 的几率装备一件苍蝇护甲，
它会破坏被替换的任意护甲部件。

desc_en: Deal 1 electric damage to yourself or an adjacent unit. Cleanse debuffs from that unit, give it a random stat up, and a 25% chance to be Stunned.
desc_zh:
对自己或一名相邻单位
造成 1 点电击伤害。
驱散该单位的减益效果，
给予其一项随机属性提升，
并有 25% 几率使其晕眩。

desc_en: Spawn a mini-nuke that makes a HUGE explosion when it dies.
desc_zh:
生成一颗迷你核弹，
它死亡时会产生巨大的爆炸。

desc_en:
Gain +6 [img:shield].
Castable only if you have no [img:shield].
desc_zh:
获得 +6 [img:shield]。
仅当没有 [img:shield] 时可施放。

desc_en: Teleport to anything that's electrically conductive. Displace units you teleport onto and deal electric damage to them.
desc_zh:
传送至任何导电物体处。
置换你传送位置上的单位
并对它们造成电击伤害。

desc_en: Smash your weapon onto an adjacent unit, destroying it and dealing double its damage.
desc_zh: 用武器猛砸前后左右相邻的1个单位，摧毁武器，本次武器伤害增大1倍。

desc_en: Lose 1 [img:shield]. Spawn a junk pile.
desc_zh: 失去 1 [img:shield]。生成一个垃圾堆。

desc_en: Lose all [img:shield], then gain [img:shield] equal to your equipment's starting [img:shield].
desc_zh:
失去所有 [img:shield]，
然后获得等于你装备初始 [img:shield] 的 [img:shield]。

desc_en: Jump to any open tile. Explode when you land. (This explosion also damages you.)
desc_zh:
跳跃至任意空地块。落地时爆炸。
（此爆炸也会伤害到你。）

desc_en: Spawn a vacuum bot that collects pickups and shares their effects with you.
desc_zh:
生成一个扫地机器人，
它可以收集掉落物并与你共享其效果。

desc_en: Spawn a nurse bot that heals allies.
desc_zh: 生成一个治疗盟友的护士机器人。

desc_en: Spawn a tesla coil that shoots lightning bolts at random units with a small chance to inflict Stun.
desc_zh:
生成一个特斯拉线圈，
向随机单位发射闪电，
有小几率施加晕眩。

desc_en: Collect a pickup in range 3. Instead of its normal effect, gain +1 Tech.
desc_zh:
收集 3 格范围内的一个掉落物。
获得 +1 科技，以替代其正常效果。

desc_en: Give an ally in range 3 a temporary copy of your weapon, if they don't have a weapon.
desc_zh:
给予 3 格范围内一名没有武器的
盟友一份你武器的临时复制品。

desc_en: Shoot electric bolts at up to 3 random enemies or robots.
desc_zh:
向最多 3 个随机敌人
或机器人发射电击弹。

desc_en: Repair 1 use to your weapon and give it +1 damage for the rest of the battle.
desc_zh:
修复你武器的 1 次使用次数，
并使其在剩余战斗中 +1 伤害。

desc_en: Becomes a random Fighter starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机战士初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Thief starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机盗贼初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Tank starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机坦克初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Mage starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机法师初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Cleric starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机牧师初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Hunter starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机猎人初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Necromancer starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机死灵法师初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Butcher starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机屠夫初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Monk starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机武僧初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Druid starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机德鲁伊初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Psychic starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机灵能者初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Tinkerer starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机工匠初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random Collarless starter ability when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机无项圈初始技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random ability from any class when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机任意职业技能。

desc_en: Becomes a random class basic attack when you lock in your team's collars.
desc_zh:
当你锁定队伍的项圈时，
变更为一个随机职业基础攻击。
